about:
# Guild Karma Tracker

Track and celebrate your guild members' contributions with a simple karma system!

## What is Guild Karma?

Guild Karma is a fun, lightweight addon that lets guild members give recognition to each other through a simple "++" system. When someone does something awesome, just type their name followed by ++ in guild chat and they'll earn karma!

## Screenshots

| Leaderboard | Activity |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![Leaderboard tab: guild members ranked by karma with class icons and ranks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GhostVox/GuildKarma/main/docs/screenshots/leaderboard.png) | ![Activity tab: who gave karma to whom, and why](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GhostVox/GuildKarma/main/docs/screenshots/activity.png) |
| **Professions** | **Karma Shop** |
| ![Professions tab: guild members grouped by profession with skill levels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GhostVox/GuildKarma/main/docs/screenshots/professions.png) | ![Shop tab: items for sale and a pending request awaiting officer approval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GhostVox/GuildKarma/main/docs/screenshots/shop.png) |
| **Schedule a run** | **Sign up by role** |
| ![Events tab: scheduling a dungeon with day, time and role slots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GhostVox/GuildKarma/main/docs/screenshots/events-schedule.png) | ![Events tab: an event's page with Tank, Healer and DPS signup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GhostVox/GuildKarma/main/docs/screenshots/events-signup.png) |

## Features

✨ **Simple Recognition System**
- Type `PlayerName++` in guild chat to give karma
- Add a reason: `PlayerName++ for the heals`
- Works even if not everyone has the addon installed
- Supports special characters in names (Kaós, José, François, etc.)
- Supports two-word names on WoW Forever (`Cut Loss++`)

🛡️ **Smart Protections**
- Prevents self-karma (no cheating!)
- Spam protection: the same player can give the same person karma once every 5 minutes
- Only guild members can receive karma
- Validates all names against the guild roster

📊 **Karma Tracking & Leaderboards**
- All-time, last 30 days and last 7 days leaderboards
- View top 10 karma holders with `/gk` or `/gk report` (add `week` or `month`)
- Check specific player karma with `/gk PlayerName`, and why they got it with `/gk history PlayerName`
- See a guild member's karma in their tooltip and in the Guild & Communities roster
- Type `guildkarma` in guild chat to see your own karma

🔄 **Multi-User Sync**
- Karma and its history sync automatically when you log in
- Type `gk update` in guild chat to sync everyone's data
- Catch up on everything you missed while offline
- Guild leader edits and resets always win over old data

🪟 **Karma Window**
- Open with the minimap button or `/gk ui`
- Your own karma and weekly gain at a glance
- **Leaderboard tab**: search, sort, class icons, guild ranks, and gold, silver and bronze for the top three; tied karma shares a place
- **Activity tab**: a feed of who gave karma to whom, and why
- Hover a member to see their recent karma and the reasons given
- Hide members with 0 karma, and post the top 10 to guild chat with one click
- Drag the minimap button around the minimap; right-click it to sync

🛒 **Karma Shop**
- Spend karma on guild bank items with `/gk shop`
- The guild master and officers list items and prices
- Request an item and an officer approves it, then hands it over
- Spending never lowers the leaderboard: your balance is karma earned minus karma spent

🛠️ **Guild Professions**
- See who has which main profession or Cooking, and their skill, with `/gk professions`
- Search by profession or member name
- Shared automatically by members running the addon, including offline members

📅 **Dungeon & Raid Events**
- Schedule runs and sign up with `/gk events`
- Anyone can post a dungeon or raid with a time, role slots and a note
- Sign up as Tank, Healer or DPS; extra signups go to a bench and move up when someone drops out
- Reminders 15 minutes before runs you're going to

👑 **Guild Leader Management**
- The guild leader can raise, lower, or set any member's karma from the window
- Reset karma for the whole guild with one click
- Leader edits and resets sync to every addon user, including those who were offline

💬 **Clean Chat Integration**
- Recipients automatically announce their new karma total
- Only one addon answers chat triggers, so there's no wall of replies
- Report leaderboards to guild chat with proper delays

## Commands

**Slash Commands:**
- `/gk ui` - Open the karma window
- `/gk shop` - Spend karma on guild bank items
- `/gk professions` - See who in the guild has which profession
- `/gk events` - Schedule dungeons and raids, and sign up
- `/gk minimap` - Show or hide the minimap button
- `/gk` - View top 10 karma holders (private)
- `/gk PlayerName` - Check specific player's karma (private)
- `/gk report` - Post top 10 to guild chat (public)
- `/gk report week` / `/gk report month` - Post the top 10 for the last 7 or 30 days (public)
- `/gk report PlayerName` - Post specific player's karma to guild chat (public)
- `/gk history [PlayerName]` - Show recent karma and the reasons given (private)
- `/gk sync` - Request karma sync from other addon users
- `/gk debug PlayerName` - Test if a name is in guild roster
- `/gk simulate Sender Name: message` - Test a guild chat line on your client only, without posting it
- `/gk reset` - Reset all karma for the guild (guild leader only)
- `/gk help` - Show all commands

**Guild Chat Triggers:**
- `PlayerName++` - Give karma to a player
- `PlayerName++ reason` - Give karma with a reason
- `guildkarma` or `karma` - Check your own karma
- `gk update` - Trigger a sync for everyone

## How It Works

1. **Anyone** (with or without the addon) can type `PlayerName++` in guild chat
2. **Everyone with the addon** automatically tracks the karma
3. **Only the recipient** announces their new total to avoid spam
4. **Players can sync** their data anytime to stay up-to-date

## Perfect For

- Recognizing helpful guild members
- Thanking raiders who performed well
- Acknowledging crafters who help with gear
- Building positive guild culture
- Having fun and friendly competition

## Installation

1. Download and extract to your `Interface/AddOns` folder
2. Restart WoW or type `/reload`
3. Share with guildmates for best experience!

## Notes

- Works on Retail (Midnight), Mists of Pandaria Classic, Cataclysm Classic, Titan Reforged, Burning Crusade Anniversary, Forever, and Classic Era / Season of Discovery
- Data is stored per-guild (multi-guild support)
- Sync feature requires at least 2 people with the addon
- More users = better coverage and more accurate karma tracking
- Karma history is kept for 35 days; all-time totals are kept forever
- On Retail, karma given during boss encounters may not be counted, because the game hides chat from addons during fights

## Development

End-to-end tests run several simulated players in a fake guild. Run them from the repository root with Lua 5.1:

```
lua tests/run.lua
```

Pushing a version tag (e.g. `1.3.0`) runs the tests, then packages the addon and uploads it to CurseForge and GitHub Releases. This needs a `CF_API_KEY` repository secret holding a CurseForge API token.

## Support

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Leave a comment below!

---

*Give karma. Get karma. Build community.* 💚

releases.notes:
# Changelog

## 1.5.0

### New
- **Dungeon and raid events** (`/gk events`): schedule a run and let guildies sign up
  - Anyone can schedule a dungeon or raid with a day, time, role slots and a note
  - Sign up as Tank, Healer or DPS, and say you're going, might come or can't go
  - Roles fill in signup order; once a role is full, extra signups wait on the bench and move up if someone drops out
  - The guild is told about new runs, the run's leader about signups, and everyone going gets a reminder 15 minutes before the start
  - The run's leader and officers can edit or cancel it; signed-up players are told if it's cancelled
  - Times show in each player's own time zone

## 1.4.0

### New
- **Karma shop** (`/gk shop`): spend karma on guild bank items
  - The guild master and officers list items and prices (shift-click an item to link it)
  - Members request an item; the karma is held until an officer approves or denies it
  - Officers approve, then hand the item over and mark it delivered
  - Spending never lowers the leaderboard: your balance is karma earned minus karma spent
  - Officers are told about new requests, and members about decisions on theirs
- **Professions tab** (`/gk professions`): see who in the guild has which profession and their skill, searchable by profession or name. Shows main professions and Cooking. Members running the addon share theirs automatically, and offline members' professions are passed along by whoever is online.

### Fixes
- WoW Forever: the addon now recognizes your own two-word name, so you announce karma you receive, your shop requests and professions are saved under your full name, and tooltips find two-word names

## 1.3.0

### New
- **Redesigned karma window**: a cleaner dark look, your own karma and weekly gain at the top, class icons and guild ranks on the leaderboard
- **Activity tab**: a feed of who gave karma to whom, when, and why
- **Reasons**: add a reason after `++`, e.g. `Cut Loss++ for the heals`. Reasons show in the Activity tab, leaderboard tooltips and `/gk history`
- **Weekly and monthly leaderboards**: switch between All time, Last 30 days and Last 7 days in the window, or post them with `/gk report week` and `/gk report month`
- **Karma in tooltips**: a guild member's karma and place show in their player tooltip and in the Guild & Communities roster
- `/gk history [name]`: print recent karma and the reasons given

### Changes
- **Spam protection**: the same player can give the same person karma once every 5 minutes
- Karma history syncs between addon users, including what you missed while offline
- Guild-wide resets also clear karma history

## 1.2.0

### New
- **Karma window** (`/gk ui`): a searchable, sortable list of guild members with class colors, online status and tooltips
- **Leaderboard places:** tied karma shares a place (1, 2, 2, 4), and players with no karma aren't ranked
- **Top 3 colors:** gold, silver and bronze for the top three places
- **"Hide 0 karma" filter**, remembered between sessions
- **"Post Top 10" button** that posts the leaderboard to guild chat
- **Minimap button:** left-click opens the karma window, right-click syncs, and you can drag it around the minimap. Use `/gk minimap` to show or hide it.
- **Guild leader tools:** raise, lower, set or reset any member's karma from the window. Changes sync to every addon user, including players who were offline when the change was made.

### Changes
- `/gk reset` now resets karma for the whole guild, and only the guild leader can use it
- `/gk` and `/gk report` use the same leaderboard as the window

### Fixes
- WoW Forever: karma now works for two-word character names (e.g. `Cut Loss++`), and names keep their capital letters
- Retail: updated for patch 12.1.5, so the addon no longer shows as out of date

## 1.1.0

### New
- Supports Retail, Mists, Cataclysm, Titan Reforged, TBC Anniversary, Forever and Classic Era

### Fixes
- Large guilds no longer break syncing: data is sent in chunks under the addon message size limit
- Only one player's addon answers `karma` / `guildkarma` in guild chat, instead of everyone's
- `gk update` sends a single sync request instead of one from each addon user
- No more errors on Retail during boss fights, when chat is locked
